verdict.rationale: Official docs cover working entirely from the command line and running Godot with the `headless` display server and Dummy audio driver on machines without a GPU or display. A runtime probe confirms a keyless one-command install to a binary that runs `godot --headless` for CI builds, exports and scripted editor automation. missing for 10: independent community or hands-on corroboration of CI pipeline usage (e.g. headless export or test runs in CI), and docs on CI-specific workflows beyond the dedicated-server context.
